entities.summary: Karl Nickerson Llewellyn was an American jurisprudential scholar associated with the school of legal realism. The Journal of Legal Studies has identified Llewellyn as one of the twenty most cited American legal scholars of the 20th century. Karl Llewellyn was a philosophers & thinkers from Seattle (1893-05-22, Seattle–1962-02-13). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
